services.name: Trolling Fishing Charters
services.desc: Captain Jim is a US Coast Guard licensed captain with 45 years of fishing and boating experience in Rhode Island, Massachusetts, California, and Mexico, with 20+ years in the Hawaiian Islands.! Times and duration Monday thru Saturday 6am thru 2pm 4, 6, 8 and 10 hour charters available About Captain Jim trolls for Hawaii’s Pelagic Fish and he’ll give you a sporting chance to catch them any time of the year. Ten minutes after getting underway the trolling lines are in the water. On the way out to the prime fishing areas, there’s a good chance of catching Mahi-Mahi, Ono and Aku. services.name: Boat Tours
services.desc: If fishing isn’t for you, book a private tour to cruise the Oahu coastline. Whale watching season is November - March, but Dolphins, Turtles, and other marine life can be spotted year-round. Enjoy views of Diamond Head and the Waikiki skyline from the KRISTA. services.name: Sunset Tours/ Friday Night Fireworks
services.desc: Captain Jim is a US Coast Guard licensed captain with 45 years of fishing and boating experience in Rhode Island, Massachusetts, California, and Mexico, with 20+ years in the Hawaiian Islands.! Times and duration Monday thru Saturday 4 or 5pm start (3hr) or 5 or 6pm start (2hr) (based on time of year) 2-hour and 3-hour boat ride available About 2 or 3 Hour Sunset Cruise. Bring your own food and drinks and enjoy the Waikiki coastline and Diamondhead while you witness an extraordinary sunset. On Friday Nights, you'll be treated to a dazzling display of Fireworks over the water from the boat!
